source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The password manager tests verify primary-password prompt field visibility/focus versus plain confirmation, choose OS reauth when enabled/available, cancel and check the password column remains hidden, then accept and verify show/hide labels and state. The negative1000ms wait is explicit historical test design, not a universal waiting rule. Key-store inability causes explicit skipped paths. No real passwords changed by this study.
title: Prove authentication cancellation leaves passwords concealed
